events.evidence: The Versailles Assembly, bringing together both the French Senate and the Chamber of Deputies, votes 560 to 181 in favour of amending the constitution to allow adoption of the EU Lisbon Treaty
U.S. President George W. Bush introduces a Federal budget of $3.1 trillion and a near-record deficit just ahead — $410 billion
A suicide bomber kills a woman and injures at least 10 people in Dimona, Israel

label.note: EU treaty progress and US deficit headline offset by Middle East violence and Iraq civilian deaths.
